name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Goldshire, the search for Stalvan Mistmantle turns to an old letter left at the inn. Its trail leads from Elwynn Forest to Stormwind's Canal District.

sections.title: A Midnight Terror
sections.body: At the Lion's Pride Inn, Innkeeper Farley remembers a stormy night from years ago. A traveling courier came in from the pouring rain to find shelter, then rushed downstairs around midnight in a panic. He wore only his sleepwear as he fled into the dark storm. No one saw him again.

sections.title: The Leftover Parcel
sections.body: The courier left his satchel and personal chest in the upstairs room when he fled. Among the forgotten cargo was an unsent letter bearing the name Stalvan, addressed to someone in Stormwind City's Canal District. The chest sat untouched at the foot of the bed until Farley allowed it to be opened.

sections.title: A Chilly Welcome
sections.body: Caretaker Folsom watches over property along Stormwind's canals near the Park. When you bring him the long-overdue letter, Stalvan's name and handwriting meet disgust and hostility instead of gratitude. Folsom's reaction points to old scandals tied to the sender.

faq.q: Where is the undelivered letter kept?
faq.answer: The undelivered letter is in a storage chest on the upper floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Climb the stairs, turn right, and enter the bedroom with the bed; the chest is at the foot of the bed frame.

faq.q: Why was the letter never delivered originally?
faq.answer: Years ago, the courier took shelter from a downpour at the Lion's Pride Inn. Near midnight, something terrified him so badly that he fled into the storm in his nightclothes, leaving his chest and deliveries behind.

faq.q: Where do I find Caretaker Folsom in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Caretaker Folsom is along the Canals in Stormwind City, near the edge of the Park district.

faq.q: Why is Caretaker Folsom angry about receiving the letter?
faq.answer: Folsom recognizes Stalvan's name and handwriting and reacts with indignation. Stalvan Mistmantle left bitter memories and outrage among the people connected to his past in Stormwind.

faq.q: How does this connect to the trouble in Duskwood?
aliases: how does this relate to duskwood
faq.answer: The town council in Darkshire is investigating a lingering evil tied to Stalvan Mistmantle. To learn who he was, you retrace his earlier travels and associations through Elwynn Forest and Stormwind.

faq.q: What happens after giving the letter to Caretaker Folsom?
faq.answer: Caretaker Folsom's sharp response opens the Stormwind chapter of the investigation. You must uncover Stalvan's former employment and the grim events involving the noble family he served.

angles.text: To unravel the mystery of Stalvan, you travel through the heartlands of the Alliance, following an old trail from Goldshire to the capital's grand canals.
As a human, you see the darker undercurrents of the Kingdom of Stormwind. The evils haunting Duskwood have roots reaching to the capital's doorstep.
